sources.finding: Income is not a natality certificate variable. County suppression and CA marital-status withholding from 2017 limit cross-tabs. Do not infer income coefficients from the age/state rates.

sources.finding: Table 7 publishes household income and income per member among women with births by marital status, not conditional birth probabilities. XLS link retrieval failed in browser and cloud proxy; numeric cells not transcribed or used. ACS sampling error is required for a later estimate.
2014 second-or-higher singleton interpregnancy spacing; 47 states and DC. Aggregate spacing cannot identify a couple utility coefficient.

maritalStatus.denominator: Married/unmarried women ages 15-44, per 1000 in respective marital groups; percent nonmarital births uses births denominator.
maritalStatus.limitation: Actual cohabiting partnership is not legal marriage. No marriage multiplier or aggregate rate enters actor choice.

territoryRegistries.finding: Health department births 2024/2025 by maternal age; territory-local reuse terms not established, no local cells shipped. Federal NCHS republication used.

method.extraction: Retained browser-rendered source excerpts with page/line locators, derivative JSON transcriptions. U.S. Virgin Islands 2023 spelling normalized to Virgin Islands; teen sub-bands excluded from eight maternal-age groups.
method.ageFootnote: 45-49 denominator includes births to mothers 50+ in numerator. Suppressed/unreliable rates remain null.
method.checkOnly: Research rates are imported only by evidence tools, never by the producer or chooser.
method.unresolved: Real county rates where published, income numeric table, cohort age-profile one-year reference changes, and any acceptance treatment for small towns or a single observed year remain for explicit review. Do not broaden the work-order test silently.

ageProfileReferenceAttempt.result: 2023 and 2024 API requests inaccessible through connected browser; cloud proxy also blocks Census downloads. No one-year age-change bound invented.
